title: Academic Zone
headline: Strong Foundations. Brighter Futures.
description: Every successful learning journey begins with a strong foundation. The Academic Zone brings together schools and academic education providers offering learning pathways for children and young people.
Whether you're choosing a school for your child or preparing for internationally recognized academic qualifications, explore the options available to support your education goals.
audience: Parents, school-age students, students considering alternative academic qualifications, and families comparing school options.
questions: What are the tuition fees and learning support services?

title: Higher Education Zone
headline: Take the Next Step Toward Your Future.
description: Your higher education journey can open doors to new knowledge, professional development, and career possibilities.

Meet universities, colleges, and business schools offering programs across different fields of study. Learn about qualifications, admissions, course structures, study options, and potential career directions.
programs: Postgraduate and Professional Study Options (where offered)
audience: High school graduates, prospective university students, degree holders seeking further study, and working professionals.
questions: What is the total program cost?

title: Language Zone
headline: Learn a Language. Open New Doors.
description: Language skills can help you communicate with confidence, prepare for international study, and expand professional opportunities.
audience: Students preparing for overseas study, language learners, job seekers, and professionals improving communication skills.

title: Skill Zone
headline: Build Skills. Create Opportunities.
description: Practical knowledge and professional skills can make a meaningful difference in your education and career journey.
The Skill Zone introduces visitors to vocational training, technical education, creative learning, and professional development opportunities.
audience: Graduates, job seekers, career changers, working professionals, and learners interested in hands-on training.
questions: What career pathways could the program support?

title: Overseas Education Zone
headline: Your Global Education Journey Starts Here.
description: Dreaming of studying abroad? Discover international education opportunities and connect with study abroad advisors and overseas education providers.
audience: Students planning international study, parents, university graduates, and learners researching scholarships.
questions: What is the total estimated study cost?
What application and visa support is offered?

title: Education Services Zone
headline: Everything You Need to Support Your Learning Journey.
description: Education goes beyond the classroom. The Education Services Zone brings together organizations offering products and services that help students, families, and professionals pursue their learning goals.
Discover useful solutions for education technology, financial planning, learning materials, and education-related travel.
audience: Students, parents, education institutions, and professionals seeking practical support.
